transforms.name: pricing-deltas-not-usd
transforms.effect: The usage upsert carries cumulativeTokens and a pricing object from codexUsagePricing. It never writes costUsd.

source.symbol: usage upsert writes pricing, never costUsd

transforms.name: price-before-reduce
transforms.effect: accept at monitor-service.ts:418-425 calls priceUsageUpdates. usage-pricing.ts:24-26 returns a finite nonnegative costUsd unchanged, including 0. If costUsd is missing, the rest of priceUsage can fill it from the catalog.

source.symbol: preserve raw costUsd, else catalog fill

transforms.name: reduce-after-price
transforms.effect: reduceMonitorAccumulator at reduce.ts:672-686 runs after priceUsageUpdates. applyUpdates at reduce.ts:239-259 stores that already priced usage update. It does not copy event.costUsd. Codex usage arrives as a semantic monitor:batch through acceptSemantic, not through this usage arm.

transforms.name: usage-index-stream
transforms.effect: buildUsageIndex at usage-index.ts:427 folds selected usage. stream at usage-index.ts:210-223 calls buildUsageCostLedger before project.ts copies a usage result.

transforms.name: ledger-counts
transforms.effect: cost.ts:21-40: a finite nonnegative costUsd, including 0, increments pricedCount and adds to the total. Missing, invalid, or negative costUsd increments unpricedCount only when canonical or pricing or cost is truthy. A plain noncanonical sample with none of those is skipped and does not increment unpricedCount.

transforms.name: coverage-decision
transforms.effect: queryUsageIndex at usage-index.ts:549 calls projectUsageCost. pricedCount > 0 and unpricedCount = 0 is complete, and the USD total may be 0. pricedCount > 0 and unpricedCount > 0 is partial. pricedCount = 0 omits this run costUsd and costRatePerMin.

transforms.name: project-usage
transforms.effect: project.ts:346-351 runs usageIndexOf and queryUsageIndex. project.ts:417 then copies that usage result. The copy does not build the cost ledger.

transforms.name: epoch-retention
transforms.effect: backend.ts:410-422 observes the projected usage before costOf. Godview main.ts:744 sets acrossEpochs accumulate, so a prior epoch costUsd can remain when the current run has pricedCount = 0. Vibefield agent-monitor.ts:480 sets acrossEpochs current and replaces that one run. burnPerHour is the current costRatePerMin times 60, not the retained sum.

transforms.name: vibefield-current-epoch
transforms.effect: Vibefield createMonitorBackend passes cost acrossEpochs current, so the backend does not sum earlier epochs.

transforms.name: history-aggregate
transforms.effect: historyOf sums costUsd from retained runs and marks coverage partial when any retained run is not complete. history.total is absent only when no retained run has costUsd.

transforms.name: row-cost
transforms.effect: costOf returns undefined when history.total is undefined, which is no retained priced total, and the row omits field.cost. Otherwise usd is the retained sum, coverage is the history coverage, and burnPerHour is the current costRatePerMin times 60 when that rate is defined.

transforms.name: derive-cost
transforms.effect: deriveAgentRow copies input.cost when costOf returned an object, including a USD total of 0. It omits cost when no retained priced total exists.

transforms.name: replica-passthrough
transforms.effect: The replica join spreads the agent row. It does not recompute cost.

transforms.name: window-passthrough
transforms.effect: window-rows spreads the row. It rewrites peer stale and drops peer profileSet. It does not recompute cost.

transforms.name: swarm-reader
transforms.effect: A working observed body reads cost coverage and burn to choose a priced flame or the unpriced flame.

transforms.name: spend-reader
transforms.effect: spendOf reads cost.usd unless coverage is unavailable or the total is missing.
